params.1273: Avoid the sorceress' guards and steal her fruit for Osman.
params.1292: Crush the fruit into empty glasses and hand it to Osman for Thieving experience. Also gives some Farming experience.
params.1274: You may attempt the gardens as often as you wish.
params.1275: Talk to Osman in Al Kharid to learn more.
params.1276: The spring, autumn and summer gardens give better experience than the winter, and unlock at 25, 45 and 65 Thieving respectively.
